name: ReanimatedHorde: aip7 is the self-resurrect delay
description: Self-resurrect (umod 34) waits 1 + aip7 frames instead of 1 + 10 x aip1, both after a successful aip8 roll and between checks while the corpse spot is occupied. The ReanimatedHorde AI no longer reads aip7: when the par5 and par6 rolls fail it thinks again on the next frame.

patches.description: Self-resurrect death hook: read aip7 instead of aip1 for the delay
Self-resurrect death hook: remove the x5 on the delay
Self-resurrect death hook: remove the x2 on the delay (delay = 1 + aip7 frames)
Self-resurrect retry while the corpse spot is occupied: read aip7 instead of aip1
Self-resurrect retry: remove the x5 on the delay
Self-resurrect retry: remove the x2 on the delay (retry = 1 + aip7 frames)
ReanimatedHorde AI: idle after failed par5 and par6 rolls is a hardcoded 0 instead of aip7 (the AI sleep turns 0 into 1 frame)
